subject: Re: ISV interop validation: LangChain/LlamaIndex SDK compatibility playtest
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura@nimbusai.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, samir.p@nimbusai.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: ISV interop validation: LangChain/LlamaIndex SDK compatibility playtest

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — Samir and I sketched a lightweight interop playtest we think will show real runtime compatibility between Nimbus SDKs (LangChain wrappers + a LlamaIndex data layer) and Redwood’s runtime/kv cache semantics.

High level ask: can we run a 2-week compatibility playtest covering:
- model call parity (streamed vs non-streamed)
- KV cache behavior for conversational workloads
- signal propagation for tracing hooks (we’ll emit a lightweight "nimbus.trace_id")
- prompt tooling compatibility (structured prompt templates and partial prompt expansion)

We attached a short spec and an editable runbook (playtest-runbook.xlsx) with suggested test cases and success criteria. Our goal is to collect quantitative diffs (latency, token counts, error rates) and a short mitigation plan for any behavioral incompatibilities.

Would Redwood be open to a co-run where your runtime team and our SDK engineers pair for two half-day sessions to exercise the scenarios?

Attaching: nimbus-redwood-interop-spec-v1.pdf (pdf) and the runbook.

Cheers,
Laura Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships
Nimbus AI

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: Laura Chen <laura@nimbusai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ISV interop validation: LangChain/LlamaIndex SDK compatibility playtest

Laura — thanks for the clear spec and runbook. This looks actionable and aligned with our ISV program goals. A few quick notes from our side before we lock dates:

- Runtime owners: I’ll roster Karthik (runtime) and Marissa (ISV success) for the pairing sessions.
- Scope suggestion: add a small test around "partial KV eviction" (short convo then cold start) — that tends to surface differences in cache semantics across wrappers.
- Tracing: we can accept a custom "nimbus.trace_id" field but we’ll want a short mapping doc so our trace ingestion can normalize it to internal spans.

Proposed timeline:
- Wed, Nov 18 — 10:00–13:00 PT: kickoff + first pairing (streaming parity + prompt tooling)
- Fri, Nov 20 — 09:00–12:00 PT: follow-up (KV scenarios + tracing)

If those work, Marissa will set up calendar invites and a shared Drive folder. Also, please add one sample test payload (JSON) to the runbook so we can pre-stage the harness.

I’m copying Marissa and Karthik to coordinate. Looking forward to the playtest.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Platform Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir.p@nimbusai.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: laura@nimbusai.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 07:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ISV interop validation: LangChain/LlamaIndex SDK compatibility playtest

Perfect — Wed/Friday windows work. Quick clarifications so you have the pre-stage payloads:

- We’ll include: a) a simple conversational chain (LLM prompt -> streaming output) b) a LlamaIndex query bundle against a small vector store (500 docs) c) a prompt-template that exercises partial expansion (template + slot injection).
- For tracing, we’ll emit nimbus.trace_id and a top-level "nimbus.hints" map with two numeric flags (cache_hit=1/0, reranked=1/0). If that’s problematic we can strip the hints and only keep the trace_id.
- Attached: a 1-page sample payload and a short "preflight checklist" we hope you’ll run on a staging Redwood instance prior to the kickoff.

We’ll upload the payloads to the Drive link you mentioned this morning.

— Samir
Senior SDK Engineer, Nimbus AI

Subject: RE: ISV interop validation: LangChain/LlamaIndex SDK compatibility playtest — mutual action plan

Thanks, team — meeting invites sent for the two sessions. Quick mutual action plan so we have clear owners: 

- Preflight (Tue Nov 17, 17:00 PT): Redwood infra runs the preflight checklist on staging. Owner: Karthik Iyer.
- Payloads uploaded: Nimbus to add sample payloads to Drive and mark the runbook row. Owner: Samir Patel.
- Pairing sessions: Wed Nov 18 (kickoff) + Fri Nov 20 (follow-up). Owners: Marissa/Marina (Marissa will lead coordination); runtime leads to join for instrumentation.
- Success criteria: 1) no >10% token-count mismatch for streaming vs non-streaming; 2) KV cache hit behavior documented with example reproducer; 3) tracing fields mapped and ingested into our tracing pipeline.

Deliverables after playtest (by Nov 27): short results doc, a set of suggested SDK tweaks (if any), and an annotation guide for the tracing mapping. We’ll capture the deliverables in HubSpot under deal NIM-2026-4491.

One small ask: can Nimbus confirm whether the partial-prompt template uses the jinja-style syntax ({{slot}}) or a different notation — we’ll set up the prompt parser accordingly.

Marissa Cole
Senior ISV Success Manager, Redwood Inference
